verdict.rationale: Aleph is a SaaS FP&A platform, so official SDKs are a fair question, but the evidence pack never mentions any SDK or client library. The 'anything with an API' connector claim covers ingesting data from other systems, not a developer SDK, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Excel and Google Sheets add-ins are end-user integrations, not SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
